## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request targets `dev`
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits, in English, with the plugin as scope (for example `fix(obs): ...`)
- [ ] `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` pass for the plugins I touched
- [ ] Both changelogs of each changed plugin are updated under `[Unreleased]` (`CHANGELOG.md` short and public, `CHANGELOG-developer.md` technical)
- [ ] No plugin folder references another plugin folder
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or local paths are included
- [ ] Docs and code are in English
